    "*\"     VALUE(WE_TABLE_TYP) LIKE  DD02L-TABCLASS",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_TABLE_CONTFLAG) LIKE  DD02L-CONTFLAG",
    "*\"     VALUE(PE_NAME_TOO_LONG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NO_OBJECT_NAME) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_R3TRTEXT_SYNTAXERROR) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LANGTYP) LIKE  TRPARI-LANGTYP",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LANGTYPA) LIKE  TRPARI-LANGTYPA",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LOGO_OBJ) LIKE  TRPARI-S_EXISTS",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CURR_SETTING) LIKE  OBJH-CURSETTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAME_TOO_LONG_FOR_OLD) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAME_WITH_NONSTANDARD_CHARS) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAMESPACE) LIKE  TRNSPACE-NAMESPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_INVALID_PREFIX_SYNTAX) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_PREFIX_NOT_ALLOWED) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CASE_SENSITIVE) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJLEN) LIKE  TLOCK-LEN",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_INVALID_LANGUAGE_FIELD) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*  check E071-key, translate to upper case if necessary,",
    "*  translate into TADIR-key, translate into TLOCK-key",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*  PE_RESULT        syntax  transport  TADIR     TLOCK",
    "*           SPACE     -         -        -         -",
    "*             S       X         -        -         -",
    "*             R       X         X        -         -",
    "*             T       X         X        X         -(no longer possible)",
    "*             L       X         X        X         X",
    "*             P     system object or illegal name selection",
    "*                   (T100, SAPL...., ... )",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* local data definitions",
    "  DATA: objlen            TYPE i,",
    "        objlen_old        TYPE i,",
    "        tmplen            TYPE i,",
    "        objmin            TYPE i,",
    "        lv_maxlklen       TYPE i,",
    "        lv_wantedlklen    TYPE i,",
    "        lv_length1        TYPE i,",
    "        lv_length2        TYPE i,",
    "        lv_tadir_maxlen   TYPE i,",
    "        lv_tadir_len      TYPE i,",
    "        lv_ddic           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_msag           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_prog           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_mark(1)        TYPE c,",
    "        lv_fctgrp         TYPE   rs38l-area,",
    "        lv_fctname        TYPE   rs38l-name,",
    "        lv_fugrname       TYPE   e071-obj_name,",
    "        lv_objname        TYPE   e071-obj_name,",
    "        lv_objlen         TYPE   i,",
    "        lv_progname       TYPE   trdir-name,",
    "        lv_comment        TYPE   tadir-obj_name,",
    "        lv_fdpos          TYPE   sy-fdpos,",
    "        lv_invalid_name   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_prefix_checked TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_prefix_found   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_wrong_syntax   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_is_ldba        TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_is_ok          TYPE   c,",
    "        lv_result         TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_stem           TYPE   e071-obj_name.",
    "",
    "",
    "  DATA: ls_dderr TYPE dderr,",
    "        ls_tlock TYPE tlock_int,",
    "        ls_tadir TYPE tadir,",
    "        ls_e071  TYPE e071.",
    "",
    "  DATA: lv_tablen LIKE SY-FDPOS,",
    "        lv_OFFSET LIKE SY-FDPOS,",
    "        lv_indname(3) type c,",
    "        lv_tabname  type dd02l-tabname,",
    "        lv_xinx_cts_name TYPE e071-obj_name.",
    "",
    "  DATA: lv_name_doc_tem(60)  TYPE c.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS:  <testobj>.",
    "",
    "  DEFINE translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "    if iv_translate_objname = 'X'.",
    "      call function 'TRINT_TRANSLATE_TO_UPPER'",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          cv_string = we_e071-obj_name.",
    "    endif.",
    "  END-OF-DEFINITION.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: tr_lpart[].",
    "  pe_result = 'F'.        \" initialize (value is used internally only)",
    "",
    "* fill output E071 and make all further changes there",
    "  we_e071 = wi_e071.",
    "",
    "  IF   we_e071-pgmid(1)    =    '*'",
    "  OR   we_e071-pgmid       =    'PASS'.",
    "    MOVE  'I'  TO  ev_langtyp.",
    "    pe_result = 'S'.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  we_lock_key-pat_len = 2.",
    "* check object name for non standard characters (UNICODE-project)",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'SCP_CHARS_ARE_SYNTACTICAL'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      string = we_e071-obj_name",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      is_ok  = lv_is_ok.",
    "  IF lv_is_ok <> 'X'.",
    "    ev_name_with_nonstandard_chars = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF we_e071-pgmid = 'LANG'.",
    "* special treatment for language objects: check filled language field",
    "    IF we_e071-lang = space OR we_e071-lang = '*'.",
    "      ev_invalid_language_field = 'X'.",
    "      pe_result = space.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CASE we_e071-pgmid.",
    "    WHEN 'LIMU' OR 'LANG'.",
    "      IF we_e071-object <> 'ADIR'.",
    "        translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      CASE we_e071-object.",
    "* only TADIR entry",
    "        WHEN 'ADIR'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'F'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          DESCRIBE FIELD ls_tadir-obj_name LENGTH  lv_tadir_maxlen",
    "                                                     IN CHARACTER MODE.",
    "          ls_e071-pgmid       =    we_e071-obj_name(4).",
    "          ls_e071-object      =    we_e071-obj_name+4(4).",
    "          ls_e071-obj_name    =    we_e071-obj_name+8(lv_tadir_maxlen).",
    "          IF   ls_e071-pgmid  =    'LIMU'",
    "          AND  ls_e071-object =    'ADIR'.",
    "            pe_result      =    ' '.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'TR_CHECK_TYPE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              wi_e071           = ls_e071",
    "            IMPORTING",
    "              pe_result         = lv_result",
    "              we_lock_key       = ls_tlock",
    "              we_tadir          = ls_tadir",
    "              ev_case_sensitive = ev_case_sensitive.",
    "          pe_result = lv_result.",
    "          IF   ev_case_sensitive <> 'X'.",
    "            translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF   we_e071-obj_name(4)      ><   ls_tadir-pgmid",
    "          OR   we_e071-obj_name+4(4)    ><   ls_tadir-object",
    "          OR   we_e071-obj_name+8(lv_tadir_maxlen)",
    "                                        ><   ls_tadir-obj_name",
    "          OR   pe_result                NA   'TL'.",
    "            pe_result                =    ' '.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "          objlen = ls_tlock-len + 8.",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len = ls_tlock-pat_len.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     = ls_tlock-obj.",
    "          we_tadir            = ls_tadir.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'ADIR' 4.",
    "",
    "* ABAP-source and texts",
    "        WHEN 'REPO'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPO' 4.",
    "",
    "* only ABAP-source.",
    "        WHEN 'REPS'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'F'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old .",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          IF we_tadir-object = 'CLAS'.",
    "** belongs to OO-ABAP, tr_lpart is already complete  (<CLAS>REPS only)",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPOREPS' 8.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* only reporttext.",
    "        WHEN 'REPT'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'L'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          IF we_tadir-object = 'CLAS'.",
    "** belongs to OO-ABAP, tr_lpart is already complete  (<CLAS>REPT only)",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPOREPT' 8.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* report variants (System variants)",
    "        WHEN 'VARI'.",
    "***Position of variant-name in E071 differs due to length of progname***",
    "***offset for reading in  E071 is calculated in LV_PROG             ****",
    "***however hikey is build with long progname in any case            ****",
    "          lv_length1     = gc_prog_old + gc_vari.",
    "          lv_length2     = STRLEN( we_e071-obj_name ).",
    "          IF lv_length2  > lv_length1.",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name   = we_e071-obj_name.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name    = we_e071-obj_name(gc_prog_old).",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name+gc_prog =",
    "                            we_e071-obj_name+gc_prog_old(gc_vari).",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog_old.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    lv_prog  + gc_vari .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old + gc_vari_old .",
    "          we_cli_dep     =   'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                 USING we_lock_key",
    "                       we_e071-object ls_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                       ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                       lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          lv_objname = we_e071-obj_name+lv_prog(gc_vari).",
    "          IF lv_objname NE space",
    "          OR we_tadir-object NE 'PROG'.",
    "* new entry LIMU VARI: specific variant",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                    USING 'VARI' 4 lv_objname gc_vari .",
    "          ELSE.",
    "* old entry LIMU VARI (rel. 2.2): all variants",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'VARI' 4.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "* report variants (application variants)",
    "        WHEN 'VARX'.",
    "          lv_length1     = gc_prog_old + gc_vari.",
    "          lv_length2     = STRLEN( we_e071-obj_name ).",
    "          IF lv_length2  > lv_length1.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog_old.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          pe_result      =    'R'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'CUST'.",
    "          objlen         =    lv_prog  + gc_vari .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old  + gc_vari_old .",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "* field selections",
    "        WHEN 'FSEL'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_fsel .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_fsel_old.",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                 USING we_lock_key",
    "                       we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                       ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                       lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'FSEL' 4.",
    "* 'Bildfolgesteuerung'",
    "        WHEN 'SSCT'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_ssct .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_ssct_old.",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'SSCT' 4.",
    "* GUI-definition",
    "        WHEN 'CUAD'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_cuad .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_cuad_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "               USING we_lock_key",
    "                     we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                     we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                     ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                     lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'CUAD' 4.",
    "* GUI-definition texts",
    "        WHEN 'CUAX'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'L'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_cuad .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_cuad_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "               USING we_lock_key",
    "                     we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                     we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                     ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                     lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING 'CUAD' 4 'CUAX' 4.",
    "",
    "* OO-ABAP: Definition of class",
    "        WHEN 'CLSD'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CLSD' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: class include/macro",
    "        WHEN 'CINC'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'F'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_prog.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          TRANSLATE we_tadir-obj_name  USING '= '.     \"remove '='",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas",
    "                     'CINC' 4  we_e071-obj_name(gc_prog) gc_prog.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Private header",
    "        WHEN 'CPRI'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CPRI' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Protected header",
    "        WHEN 'CPRO'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CPRO' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Public header",
    "        WHEN 'CPUB'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CPUB' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Mapping information",
    "        WHEN 'MAPP'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'F'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'MAPP' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Method",
    "        WHEN 'METH'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas + gc_meth.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'METH' 4",
    "                       we_e071-obj_name+gc_clas(gc_meth) gc_meth.",
    "* page (belonging to Business Server Page application)",
    "        WHEN 'WAPP'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_wapa + gc_wapp.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'WAPA'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_wapa).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_wapa.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_wapa 'WAPP' 4",
    "                       we_e071-obj_name+gc_wapa(gc_wapp) gc_wapp.",
    "* attributes of Business Server Page application",
    "        WHEN 'WAPD'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_wapa.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'WAPA'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_wapa).",

    "*                      USING WE_TADIR-OBJ_NAME GC_MCOD",
    "*                            'MCOD' 4",
    "*                            'MCOF' 4.",
    "",
    "* matchcode id",
    "        WHEN 'MCID'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_mcid .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_mcid_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    we_e071-object.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_mcid).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_mcid .",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2",
    "                  TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                   USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_mcid 'MCID' 4.",
    "",
    "* Texts of matchcode id",
    "        WHEN 'MCIX'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'L'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_mcid .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_mcid_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'MCID'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_mcid).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_mcid .",
    "          MOVE  we_tadir-object  TO  we_lock_key-obj.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_e071-obj_name(gc_mcid) gc_mcid",
    "                  'MCID' 4 'MCIX' 4.",
    "",
    "* search help definition",
    "        WHEN 'SHLD'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_ddic .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_ddic_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'SHLP'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_ddic).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic  'SHLD' 4.",
    "",
    "* Texts of search help definition",
    "        WHEN 'SHLX'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'L'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_ddic .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_ddic_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'SHLP'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_ddic).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "          MOVE  we_tadir-object  TO  we_lock_key-obj.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING  we_e071-obj_name(gc_ddic) gc_ddic",
    "                         'SHLD' 4  'SHLX' 4.",
    "",
    "* typ-classes",
    "        WHEN 'TYPD'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_type .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_type_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'TYPE'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_type).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_type .",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_type 'TYPD' 4.",
    "",
    "* Texts of typ-classes",
    "        WHEN 'TYPX'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'L'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_type .",
    "          objlen_old          =    gc_type_old .",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'TYPE'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_type).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_type .",
    "          we_lock_key-obj   = we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_type 'TYPD' 4  'TYPX' 4.",
    "",
    "* documentation",
    "        WHEN 'DOCU'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'S'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'L'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_objname          =    we_e071-obj_name.",
    "",
    "          CASE we_e071-obj_name(2).",
    "            WHEN 'XP' OR 'XQ' .",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    42 .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              CASE  we_e071-obj_name(2).",
    "                WHEN 'XP' .",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'XPDT'.",
    "                WHEN  'XQ' .",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'XPDA'.",
    "              ENDCASE.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =  we_e071-obj_name+2(40).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len = 40 .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =   we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_tadir-obj_name 40",
    "                        'DOCU' 4",
    "                        we_e071-obj_name(2) 2.",
    "* general texts",
    "            WHEN  'SA' OR 'SE' OR 'SI' OR 'SG'.",
    "* these docu name is something special.",
    "* 1st key: \tAlert-/Event Type ID (GUID 32, upper case)",
    "* 2nd key:  Product ID (Char 26, upper case)",
    "* Only first key relevant for logical transport object R3TR ACFG.",
    "* Additional logical transport object R3TR ACPR for product context",
    "* (not *relevant for docs). Concatenation of both keys",
    "*  identifies document.",
    "",
    "* save original (full) doc name",
    "         lv_name_doc_tem  = we_e071-obj_name.",
    "*  cut it to 2(docu class) + 32(tadirname). this is",
    "* normal case for docu name/tadir name",
    "* ( At the end of coding, wrestore the full docu name.",
    "              we_e071-obj_name = we_e071-obj_name(34).",
    "* treat the cuted  docu name as usual. get the tadir name",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    34.",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =   'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =   'ACFG'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =  we_e071-obj_name+2(32).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len = 32 .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =   we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_tadir-obj_name 32",
    "                        'DOCU' 4",
    "                        we_e071-obj_name(2) 2.",
    "            WHEN 'TX'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "* not transportable if key > 30",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'DOCT'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   = we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_docu).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    STRLEN( we_tadir-obj_name ).",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              IF   we_e071-obj_name+2  ><   we_tadir-obj_name.",
    "                pe_result      =    space.",
    "                pe_name_too_long =  k_x.",
    "                ev_objlen = gc_docu.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_docu 'DOCU' 4.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "* syntax docu",
    "            WHEN 'SD'.",
    "              lv_length1 = gc_synd .",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len = 4.",
    "              CASE we_e071-obj_name+2(4).",
    "                WHEN 'ABAP'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'ABAP'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                          USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                                'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN 'ABEN'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'ABEN'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                          USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                                'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN 'RSYN'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'RSYN'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                          USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                                'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN 'CONT'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'CONT'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                          USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                               'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN 'DDIC'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'DDIC'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                          USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                               'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN 'DYNP'.",
    "                  pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                  we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                  we_tadir-object     =    'SYND'.",
    "                  we_tadir-obj_name   =    'DYNP'.",
    "                  we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                  PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                         USING we_tadir-obj_name 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+6(lv_length1) lv_length1",
    "                               'DOCUSD' 6.",
    "                WHEN OTHERS.",
    "                  pe_result  =  space.",
    "              ENDCASE.",
    "* program docu",
    "            WHEN 'RE'.",
    "              pe_result     =  'L'.",
    "              objlen        =  2 + gc_prog .",
    "              objlen_old    =  2 + gc_prog_old .",
    "              lv_objname    =  we_e071-obj_name+2.",
    "              PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING we_lock_key",
    "                            we_e071-object lv_objname pe_result",
    "                            we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object",
    "                            we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                            ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                            lv_prefix_checked.",
    "              IF we_tadir-pgmid = 'R3TR'",
    "                AND we_tadir-object = 'CNTX'.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING 'DOCU' 4 'RE' 2 lv_objname gc_prog.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                lv_tadir_len  =    gc_prog.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                                      USING 'DOCU' 4 'RE' 2.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* web dynpo docu",
    "            WHEN 'WD'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    2 + gc_wdyn .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'WDYN'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_wdyn).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_wdyn.",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_wdyn 'DOCU' 4 'WD' 2.",
    "",
    "* system log docu",
    "            WHEN 'SL'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    5.",
    "              objlen_old          =    5.",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'SYAG'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   = we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_syag).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_syag .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_syag 'DOCU' 4   'SL' 2.",
    "* docu to OO-ABAP class (for class, attributes, methods, events, types)",
    "            WHEN 'CL' OR 'CA' OR 'CO' OR 'CE' OR 'CT'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              IF we_e071-obj_name(2) = 'CL'.",
    "                objlen          =    2 + gc_clas .",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                objlen          =    2 + gc_clas + gc_docu .",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_clas).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              IF we_e071-obj_name(2) = 'CL'.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'DOCU' 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name(2) 2.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                lv_length1 = 2 + gc_clas.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part4 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'DOCU' 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name(2) 2",
    "                           we_e071-obj_name+lv_length1(gc_docu) gc_docu.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "* docu to OO-ABAP interface (for interface, attributes, methods, events)",
    "            WHEN 'IF' OR 'IA' OR 'IO' OR 'IE'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              IF we_e071-obj_name(2) = 'IF'.",
    "                objlen          =    2 + gc_intf .",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                objlen          =    2 + gc_intf + gc_docu .",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'INTF'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_intf).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_intf .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              IF we_e071-obj_name(2) = 'IF'.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_intf",
    "                             'DOCU' 4 we_e071-obj_name(2) 2.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                lv_length1 = 2 + gc_intf.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part4 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                        USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_intf 'DOCU' 4",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name(2) 2",
    "                           we_e071-obj_name+lv_length1(gc_docu) gc_docu.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "* domain docu",
    "            WHEN 'DO'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    2 + gc_ddic .",
    "              objlen_old          =    2 + gc_ddic_old .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'DOMA'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_ddic).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4 'DO' 2.",
    "* constant values docu (sub of domains)",
    "            WHEN 'VA'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    2 + gc_ddic .",
    "              objlen_old          =    2 + gc_ddic_old .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'DOMA'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_ddic).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4 'VA' 2.",
    "* rollname docu",
    "            WHEN 'DE'.",
    "              lv_objname = we_e071-obj_name+2.",
    "              PERFORM check_obj_name_tab USING  lv_objname",
    "                                                lv_invalid_name.",
    "              IF lv_invalid_name <> space.",
    "                pe_result           =    space.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                objlen              =    2 + gc_ddic .",
    "                objlen_old          =    2 + gc_ddic_old .",
    "                we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                we_tadir-object     =    'DTEL'.",
    "                we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                                we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_ddic).",
    "                we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "                we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                       USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4 'DE' 2.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "* rollname details docu",
    "            WHEN 'DZ'.",
    "              lv_objname = we_e071-obj_name+2.",
    "              PERFORM check_obj_name_tab USING  lv_objname",
    "                                                lv_invalid_name.",
    "              IF lv_invalid_name <> space.",
    "                pe_result           =    space.",
    "              ELSE.",
    "                tmplen     = STRLEN( we_e071-obj_name+2 ).",
    "                lv_length1 = gc_ddic_old + gc_docu_ext.",
    "                IF tmplen  > lv_length1.",
    "                  lv_ddic = tmplen - gc_docu_ext.   \"(> gc_ddic_old)",
    "                  objlen  = 2 + gc_ddic + gc_docu_ext.",
    "                ELSE.",
    "                  lv_ddic = gc_ddic_old.",
    "                  objlen  = 2 + gc_ddic_old + gc_docu_ext.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "                objlen_old          =   2 + gc_ddic_old",
    "                                                + gc_docu_ext_old.",
    "                we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "                we_tadir-object     =    'DTEL'.",
    "                we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name+2(lv_ddic).",
    "                we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "                we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "                lv_length2          =    2 + lv_ddic .",
    "                PERFORM tr_next_part4 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                       USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4  'DZ' 2",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+lv_length2(gc_docu_ext)",
    "                              gc_docu_ext.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "* table docu",
    "            WHEN 'TB'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    2 + gc_ddic .",
    "              objlen_old          =    2 + gc_ddic_old .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'TABL'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_ddic).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4 'TB' 2.",
    "",
    "* table type docu",
    "            WHEN 'TT'.",
    "              pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "              objlen              =    2 + gc_ddic .",
    "              objlen_old          =    2 + gc_ddic_old .",
    "              we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "              we_tadir-object     =    'TTYP'.",
    "              we_tadir-obj_name   =",
    "                              we_e071-obj_name+2(gc_ddic).",
    "              we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_ddic .",
    "              we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "              PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                      USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_ddic 'DOCU' 4 'TT' 2.",
    "",
    "* extension-index",
    "            WHEN 'XI'.",
    "",

    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",

    "            WI_DIALOG      = WI_DIALOG",
    "            WI_SEL_E070    = 'X'",
    "            WI_SEL_E07T    = 'X'",

    "FUNCTION cts_api_create_change_request.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(DESCRIPTION) TYPE  TEXT60",
    "*\"     VALUE(CATEGORY) TYPE  CHAR01",
    "*\"     VALUE(CLIENT) TYPE  CHAR3",
    "*\"     VALUE(OWNER) TYPE  CHAR012",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(REQUEST) TYPE  CHAR20",
    "*\"     VALUE(RETCODE) TYPE  CHAR3",
    "*\"     VALUE(MESSAGE) TYPE  TEXT80",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "DATA: lv_shorttext           TYPE e07t-as4text,",
    "      lv_trfunc              TYPE e070-trfunction,",
    "      lv_client              TYPE e070c-client,",
    "      lv_user                TYPE e070-as4user,",
    "      lv_trkorr              TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_req_type(15)        TYPE c,",
    "      lv_text(80)            TYPE c.",
    "",
    "* reset export parameter",
    "  CLEAR request.",
    "  CLEAR retcode.",
    "  CLEAR message.",
    "",
    "* check and convert import parameter",
    "  IF description IS INITIAL.                          \" description",
    "    retcode = '001'.",
    "    MESSAGE s001.",
    "    convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    create_alert gc_wbo",
    "                 gc_create_req",
    "                 'DESCRIPTION_MISSING'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_shorttext = description.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF category <> 'K' AND                              \" category",
    "     category <> 'W'.",
    "    retcode = '002'.",
    "    MESSAGE s002 WITH category.",
    "    convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    create_alert gc_wbo",
    "                 gc_create_req",
    "                 'INVALID_CATEGORY'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_trfunc = category.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF client IS INITIAL.                               \" client",
    "    lv_client = sy-mandt.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_client = client.",
    "    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t000",
    "                    WHERE mandt = lv_client.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      retcode = '003'.",
    "      MESSAGE s003 WITH lv_client.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      create_alert gc_wbo",
    "                   gc_create_req",
    "                   'INVALID_CLIENT'.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF owner IS INITIAL.                                \" owner",
    "    lv_user = sy-uname.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_user = owner.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* create request",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_INSERT_NEW_COMM'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            wi_kurztext           = lv_shorttext",
    "            wi_trfunction         = lv_trfunc",
    "            iv_username           = lv_user",
    "            wi_client             = lv_client",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            we_trkorr             = lv_trkorr",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            no_systemname         = 1",
    "            no_systemtype         = 2",
    "            no_authorization      = 3",
    "            db_access_error       = 4",
    "            file_access_error     = 5",
    "            enqueue_error         = 6",
    "            number_range_full     = 7",
    "            invalid_input         = 8",
    "            OTHERS                = 99.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 0.                                           \" request created",
    "      request = lv_trkorr.",
    "      retcode = '000'.",
    "      IF lv_trfunc = 'W'.",
    "        lv_req_type = 'Customizing'(tyw).",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        lv_req_type = 'Workbench'(tyk).",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_req_type lv_trkorr",
    "                        lv_user lv_client.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      lv_text = 'Auftrag & angelegt'(c00).",
    "      REPLACE '&' IN lv_text WITH lv_trkorr.",
    "      create_log_record gc_wbo",
    "                        gc_create_req",
    "                        lv_text.",
    "    WHEN 3.                                           \" no authority",

    "                   'READ_CLIENT_FAILED'.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    LOOP AT ls_wbo_clients INTO ls_wbo_client",
    "            WHERE system-sysnam = ls_sys-sysnam.",
    "      IF ls_wbo_client-alert-id <> space.",
    "        retcode = '005'.",
    "        MESSAGE s013 WITH ls_sys-sysnam.",
    "        convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "        create_alert gc_cfg",
    "                     gc_import_req",
    "                     'READ_CLIENT_FAILED'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      READ TABLE ls_wbo_client-t000",
    "                 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS",
    "                 WITH KEY mandt = lv_client.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        retcode = '006'.",
    "        MESSAGE s014 WITH lv_client ls_sys-sysnam.",
    "        convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "        create_alert gc_cfg",
    "                     gc_import_req",
    "                     'INVALID_CLIENT'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* convert input parameter",
    "  lv_src_sys = sy-sysid.                              \" source",
    "  ls_target-target    = lv_system.                    \" target",
    "  ls_target-tarclient = lv_client.",
    "  ls_target-imp_again = 'X'.",
    "  APPEND ls_target TO lt_target.",
    "  LOOP AT requests INTO ls_cts_req.                   \" requests",
    "    ls_request-request = ls_cts_req-request.",
    "    APPEND ls_request TO lt_request.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "* start import",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TMS_MGR_IMPORT_TR_PROPOSAL'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_src_sys                 = lv_src_sys",
    "            iv_all_alerts              = space",
    "            iv_online                  = 'X'",
    "            iv_ignore_lock             = space",
    "            iv_monitor                 = 'X'",
    "            iv_verbose                 = space",
    "            it_requst                  = lt_request",
    "            it_target                  = lt_target",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            et_tpstat_key              = lt_tpstat_key",
    "            et_alert                   = lt_alerts",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            read_config_failed         = 1",
    "            table_of_requests_is_empty = 2",
    "            table_of_targets_is_empty  = 3",
    "            OTHERS                     = 99.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    retcode = '008'.",
    "    convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    create_alert gc_cfg",
    "                 gc_import_req",
    "                 'IMPORT_REQUEST_FAILED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* analyse alerts",
    "  LOOP AT lt_alerts INTO ls_alerts.",
    "    ls_alert = ls_alerts-alert.",
    "    IF ls_alert-function = 'TMS_TP_IMPORT' AND        \" rc = 8",
    "       ls_alert-error = 'TP_REPORTED_INFO'.",
    "      retcode = '009'.",
    "      MESSAGE s016.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    ELSEIF ls_alert-function = 'TMS_TP_IMPORT' AND    \" rc > 8",
    "           ls_alert-error = 'TP_REPORTED_ERROR'.",
    "      retcode = '010'.",
    "      MESSAGE s017.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ELSEIF ls_alert-error = 'USER_ACCESS_DENIED'.     \" no authority",
    "      retcode = '011'.",
    "      convert_alert_to_msg.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ELSE.                                             \" other error",
    "      retcode = '012'.",
    "      MESSAGE s018.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "* analyse import result",
    "  READ TABLE lt_tpstat_key INTO ls_tpstat_key INDEX 1.",
    "  lv_tpstat_key = ls_tpstat_key-tp_stat_key.",
    "  IF lv_tpstat_key IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_start_date = sy-datum - 1.",
    "    lv_start_time = '000000'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_start_date = lv_tpstat_key(8).",
    "    lv_start_time = lv_tpstat_key+8(6).",
    "    IF lv_start_time > '120000'.            \" clocks may be different",
    "      lv_start_time = '000001'.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      lv_start_date = lv_start_date - 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  lv_end_date = sy-datum.",
    "  lv_end_time = '235959'.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TMS_TM_GET_TRLIST'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_system        = lv_system",
    "            iv_startdate     = lv_start_date",
    "            iv_starttime     = lv_start_time",
    "            iv_enddate       = lv_end_date",
    "            iv_endtime       = lv_end_time",
    "            iv_trsteps       = '*'",
    "            iv_allcli        = 'X'",
    "            iv_imports       = 'X'",
    "            iv_tpstat_key    = lv_tpstat_key",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            et_tmstpalog     = lt_tp_alogs",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            alert            = 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    retcode = '013'.",
    "    MESSAGE s019.",
    "    convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    LOOP AT requests INTO ls_cts_req.",
    "      READ TABLE lt_tp_alogs INTO ls_tp_alog",
    "                 WITH KEY trkorr = ls_cts_req-request.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        CASE ls_tp_alog-retcode.",
    "          WHEN '0000'",
    "            OR '0001'",
    "            OR '0002'",
    "            OR '0003'",
    "            OR '0004'",
    "            OR '0005'",
    "            OR '0006'",
    "            OR '0007'.",
    "            ls_cts_req-retcode = '000'.",
    "          WHEN '0008'.",
    "            ls_cts_req-retcode = '008'.",
    "          WHEN OTHERS.",
    "            ls_cts_req-retcode = '012'.",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "        MODIFY requests FROM ls_cts_req.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* create nice message and log result in TMS alert viewer",
    "  IF NOT retcode IS INITIAL.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  retcode = '000'.",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_request LINES lv_nr_of_reqs.",
    "  IF lv_nr_of_reqs = 1.",
    "    LOOP AT lt_request INTO ls_request.",
    "      MESSAGE s010 WITH ls_request-request",
    "                        lv_system lv_client.",
    "      convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "      lv_text = 'Auftrag & importiert'(i00).",
    "      REPLACE '&' WITH ls_request-request INTO lv_text.",
    "      CONDENSE lv_text.",
    "      create_log_record gc_tp",
    "                        gc_import_req",
    "                        lv_text.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    MESSAGE s011 WITH lv_nr_of_reqs",
    "                      lv_system lv_client.",
    "    convert_msg_to_text message.",
    "    lv_text = '& Aufträge importiert'(i01).",
    "    lv_c10 = lv_nr_of_reqs.",
    "    SHIFT lv_c10 LEFT DELETING LEADING space.",
    "    REPLACE '&' WITH lv_c10 INTO lv_text.",
    "    CONDENSE lv_text.",
    "    create_log_record gc_tp",
    "                      gc_import_req",
    "                      lv_text.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."

    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TARGET) TYPE  TR_TARGET OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(IT_ATTRIBUTES) TYPE  SCTS_ATTRS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(IT_USERS) TYPE  SCTS_USERS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TARDEVCL) TYPE  TARDEVCL OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DEVCLASS) TYPE  DEVCLASS OPTIONAL",

    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",

    "*\"      ENQUEUE_FAILED",

    "  DATA: ls_e070              LIKE e070,",
    "        ls_e070c             LIKE e070c,",
    "        ls_e07t              LIKE e07t,",
    "        ls_e070m             LIKE e070m,",
    "        ls_task_header       TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "        ls_user              TYPE scts_user,",
    "        lv_lines             TYPE i,",
    "        lv_current_client    type e070c-client.",
    "",
    " lv_current_client = sy-mandt.",
    "",
    "*---check given attributes----------------------------------------------",
    "  perform check_attributes       using it_attributes.",
    "",
    "*---create request------------------------------------------------------",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_INSERT_NEW_COMM'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            wi_kurztext   = iv_text",
    "            wi_trfunction = iv_type",
    "            iv_username   = iv_owner",
    "            iv_tarsystem  = iv_target",
    "            wi_client     = lv_current_client",
    "            iv_tardevcl   = iv_tardevcl",
    "            iv_devclass   = iv_devclass",
    "            iv_tarlayer   = iv_tarlayer",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            we_e070       = ls_e070",
    "            we_e07t       = ls_e07t",
    "            we_e070c      = ls_e070c",
    "            es_e070m      = ls_e070m",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS        = 1.",
    "",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    current_message_raising insert_failed.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*---fill return structure-----------------------------------------------",
    "  CLEAR: es_request_header.",
    "  es_request_header-as4text_filled    = 'X'.",
    "  es_request_header-clients_filled    = 'X'.",
    "  IF ls_e070m-trkorr <> space.",
    "    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070m TO  es_request_header.",
    "    es_request_header-e070m_filled = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e07t  TO  es_request_header.",
    "  MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070c TO  es_request_header.",
    "  MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070  TO  es_request_header.",
    "",
    "*---move of objects: append objects directly----------------------------",
    "  IF  iv_type = tmvd",
    "  AND es_request_header-devclass <> space.",
    "",
    "    PERFORM enqueue_request_e  USING    es_request_header-trkorr.",
    "",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_COMPLETE_REQUEST'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              iv_header_not_filled = ' '",
    "              iv_e071_not_filled   = ' '",
    "              iv_without_update    = ' '",
    "         CHANGING",
    "              cs_request_header    = es_request_header",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS               = 1.",
    "",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "      PERFORM dequeue_request   USING es_request_header-trkorr.",
    "      current_message_raising insert_failed.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    PERFORM dequeue_request   USING es_request_header-trkorr.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*---create tasks for users (request type: workbench or customizing)",
    "  IF iv_type CA project_type.",
    "    PERFORM enqueue_request_e  USING    es_request_header-trkorr.",
    "",
    "    IF iv_type = tcor.                 \"customizing request",
    "      ls_user-type = tcut.             \"customizing task",
    "      MODIFY it_users FROM ls_user TRANSPORTING type",
    "                      WHERE type <> tcut. \"correction",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      ls_user-type = tuco.",
    "      MODIFY it_users FROM ls_user TRANSPORTING type",
    "                      WHERE NOT type CA wbtasktype.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    SORT it_users BY user type.",
    "    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM it_users COMPARING user type.",
    "    DELETE it_users WHERE user = space.",
    "",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE it_users LINES lv_lines.",
    "    IF lv_lines > 0.",
    "",
    "      LOOP AT it_users INTO ls_user.",
    "",

    "",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_INSERT_NEW_COMM'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  wi_kurztext   = iv_text",
    "                  wi_trfunction = ls_user-type",
    "                  iv_username   = ls_user-user",
    "                  wi_strkorr    = es_request_header-trkorr",

    "FUNCTION tr_release_request .",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRKORR) LIKE  E070-TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DIALOG) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_AS_BACKGROUND_JOB) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SUCCESS_MESSAGE) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DISPLAY_EXPORT_LOG) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ES_REQUEST) TYPE  TRWBO_REQUEST",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ET_DELETED_TASKS) TYPE  TRWBO_T_E070",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      CTS_INITIALIZATION_FAILURE",
    "*\"      ENQUEUE_FAILED",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORIZATION",
    "*\"      INVALID_REQUEST",
    "*\"      REQUEST_ALREADY_RELEASED",
    "*\"      REPEAT_TOO_EARLY",
    "*\"      ERROR_IN_EXPORT_METHODS",
    "*\"      OBJECT_CHECK_ERROR",
    "*\"      DOCU_MISSING",
    "*\"      DB_ACCESS_ERROR",
    "*\"      ACTION_ABORTED_BY_USER",
    "*\"      EXPORT_FAILED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA:  lv_subrc                  LIKE sy-subrc,",
    "         lv_uname                  LIKE sy-uname,",
    "         lv_trfunction             LIKE e070-trfunction,",
    "         lv_continue               TYPE trboolean       VALUE 'X',",
    "         lv_without_objects_check  TYPE trboolean,",
    "         lv_without_locking        TYPE trboolean,",
    "         lt_messages               TYPE ctsgerrmsgs,",
    "         ls_message                TYPE ctsgerrmsg.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR es_request.",
    "",
    "*---Request must not be space-------------------------------------------",
    "  IF iv_trkorr = space.",
    "    MESSAGE e047(tk) RAISING invalid_request.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*---Read request type for authority check-------------------------------",
    "  SELECT SINGLE trfunction FROM e070 INTO lv_trfunction",
    "                           WHERE trkorr = iv_trkorr.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    MESSAGE e806(tr) WITH iv_trkorr RAISING invalid_request.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*---authority check-----------------------------------------------------",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_trfunction = lv_trfunction",
    "            iv_activity   = 'RELE'",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS        = 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    current_message_raising no_authorization.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  WHILE lv_continue = 'X'.",
    "",
    "*---enqueue request-----------------------------------------------------",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              trkorr         = iv_trkorr",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              foreign_lock   = 1",
    "              system_failure = 2.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        lv_uname = sy-msgv1.",
    "        MESSAGE e133(tk) WITH iv_trkorr lv_uname RAISING enqueue_failed.",
    "      WHEN 2.",
    "        current_message_raising enqueue_failed.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "*---call trint_release_request------------------------------------------",
    "    CLEAR lt_messages.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_RELEASE_REQUEST'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              iv_trkorr                   = iv_trkorr",
    "              iv_dialog                   = iv_dialog",
    "              iv_as_background_job        = iv_as_background_job",
    "              iv_success_message          = iv_success_message",
    "              iv_without_objects_check    = lv_without_objects_check",
    "              iv_without_locking          = lv_without_locking",
    "              iv_display_export_log       = iv_display_export_log",
    "         IMPORTING",
    "              es_request                  = es_request",
    "              et_deleted_tasks            = et_deleted_tasks",
    "              et_messages                 = lt_messages",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              cts_initialization_failure  = 1",
    "              enqueue_failed              = 2",
    "              no_authorization            = 3",
    "              invalid_request             = 4",
    "              request_already_released    = 5",
    "              repeat_too_early            = 6",
    "              object_lock_error           = 7",
    "              object_check_error          = 8",
    "              docu_missing                = 9",
    "              db_access_error             = 10",
    "              action_aborted_by_user      = 11",
    "              export_failed               = 12",
    "              execute_objects_check       = 13",
    "              release_in_bg_mode          = 14",
    "              release_in_bg_mode_w_objchk = 15",
    "              error_in_export_methods     = 16",
    "              object_lang_error           = 17.",
    "",
    "    lv_subrc = sy-subrc.",
    "",
    "*---dequeue request-----------------------------------------------------",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'DEQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              trkorr = iv_trkorr.",
    "",
    "    CASE lv_subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.  lv_continue = ' '.",
    "      WHEN 1.  current_message_raising cts_initialization_failure.",
    "      WHEN 2.  current_message_raising enqueue_failed.",
    "      WHEN 3.  current_message_raising no_authorization.",
    "      WHEN 4.  current_message_raising invalid_request.",
    "      WHEN 5.  current_message_raising request_already_released.",
    "      WHEN 6.  current_message_raising repeat_too_early.",
    "      WHEN 7.",
    "        PERFORM handle_lock_errors USING    es_request",
    "                                            iv_dialog",
    "                                            lt_messages",
    "                                   CHANGING lv_without_locking.",
    "",
    "      WHEN 8.  current_message_raising object_check_error.",
    "      WHEN 9.  current_message_raising docu_missing.",
    "      WHEN 10. current_message_raising db_access_error.",
    "      WHEN 11. current_message_raising action_aborted_by_user.",
    "      WHEN 12. current_message_raising export_failed.",
    "      WHEN 13.",
    "        PERFORM inspect_objects  USING    es_request iv_dialog",
    "                                 CHANGING lv_without_objects_check.",
    "      WHEN 14.",
    "        lv_without_objects_check = 'X'.",
    "        PERFORM release_in_bg_mode USING iv_trkorr",
    "                                         lv_without_objects_check",
    "                                         lv_without_locking.",
    "      WHEN 15.",
    "        lv_without_objects_check = ' '.",
    "        PERFORM release_in_bg_mode USING iv_trkorr",
    "                                         lv_without_objects_check",
    "                                         lv_without_locking.",
    "",
    "      WHEN 16. current_message_raising error_in_export_methods .",
    "",
    "",
    "      WHEN 17.",
    "        IF iv_dialog = 'X'.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'TR_DISPLAY_REQ_CHECK_MESSAGES'",
    "               EXPORTING",
    "                    it_messages = lt_messages",
    "                    it_objects  = es_request-objects",
    "                    it_keys     = es_request-keys",
    "                    iv_title    = text-p03",
    "               EXCEPTIONS",
    "                    OTHERS      = 0.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "        IF lt_messages IS INITIAL.",
    "          MESSAGE e420(cusdir) RAISING object_check_error.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO ls_message.",
    "          MESSAGE ID     ls_message-msgid",
    "                  TYPE   ls_message-msgty",
    "                  NUMBER ls_message-msgno",
    "                  WITH   ls_message-msgv1 ls_message-msgv2",
    "                         ls_message-msgv3 ls_message-msgv4.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  ENDWHILE.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

      "description": "Type of language dependency of object"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_LOGO_OBJ",
      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_EXISTS",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "X - object is a TLOGO object"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_CURR_SETTING",
      "typeName": "OBJH-CURSETTING",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "X - object belongs to current settings"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_NAME_TOO_LONG_FOR_OLD",
      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Object name is too long (according to rules prior to 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_NAME_WITH_NONSTANDARD_CHARS",
      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Object name contains invalid characters"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_NAMESPACE",
      "typeName": "TRNSPACE-NAMESPACE",

    },

      "name": "EV_INVALID_PREFIX_SYNTAX",
      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Prefix of the object name is incorrect"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_PREFIX_NOT_ALLOWED",
      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Object name prefix not valid for object type"
    },
    {

      "typeName": "TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": ""
    },
    {

      "typeName": "TLOCK-LEN",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Maximum name length for object type"
    },
    {
      "name": "EV_INVALID_LANGUAGE_FIELD",
