  "source": [
    "FUNCTION tr_check_type.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Local Interface:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_E071) LIKE  E071 STRUCTURE  E071",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRANSLATE_OBJNAME) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(PE_RESULT) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_E071) LIKE  E071 STRUCTURE  E071",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_LOCK_KEY) LIKE  TLOCK_INT STRUCTURE  TLOCK_INT",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_TADIR) LIKE  TADIR STRUCTURE  TADIR",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_COMPLETE_ONLY) LIKE  TRPARI-W_COMPLETE",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_CATEGORY) LIKE  E070-KORRDEV",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_CLI_DEP) LIKE  TRPARI-W_CLI_DEP",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_TABLE_TYP) LIKE  DD02L-TABCLASS",
    "*\"     VALUE(WE_TABLE_CONTFLAG) LIKE  DD02L-CONTFLAG",
    "*\"     VALUE(PE_NAME_TOO_LONG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NO_OBJECT_NAME) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_R3TRTEXT_SYNTAXERROR) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LANGTYP) LIKE  TRPARI-LANGTYP",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LANGTYPA) LIKE  TRPARI-LANGTYPA",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_LOGO_OBJ) LIKE  TRPARI-S_EXISTS",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CURR_SETTING) LIKE  OBJH-CURSETTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAME_TOO_LONG_FOR_OLD) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAME_WITH_NONSTANDARD_CHARS) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_NAMESPACE) LIKE  TRNSPACE-NAMESPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_INVALID_PREFIX_SYNTAX) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_PREFIX_NOT_ALLOWED) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CASE_SENSITIVE) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJLEN) LIKE  TLOCK-LEN",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_INVALID_LANGUAGE_FIELD) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*  check E071-key, translate to upper case if necessary,",
    "*  translate into TADIR-key, translate into TLOCK-key",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*  PE_RESULT        syntax  transport  TADIR     TLOCK",
    "*           SPACE     -         -        -         -",
    "*             S       X         -        -         -",
    "*             R       X         X        -         -",
    "*             T       X         X        X         -(no longer possible)",
    "*             L       X         X        X         X",
    "*             P     system object or illegal name selection",
    "*                   (T100, SAPL...., ... )",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* local data definitions",
    "  DATA: objlen            TYPE i,",
    "        objlen_old        TYPE i,",
    "        tmplen            TYPE i,",
    "        objmin            TYPE i,",
    "        lv_maxlklen       TYPE i,",
    "        lv_wantedlklen    TYPE i,",
    "        lv_length1        TYPE i,",
    "        lv_length2        TYPE i,",
    "        lv_tadir_maxlen   TYPE i,",
    "        lv_tadir_len      TYPE i,",
    "        lv_ddic           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_msag           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_prog           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_mark(1)        TYPE c,",
    "        lv_fctgrp         TYPE   rs38l-area,",
    "        lv_fctname        TYPE   rs38l-name,",
    "        lv_fugrname       TYPE   e071-obj_name,",
    "        lv_objname        TYPE   e071-obj_name,",
    "        lv_objlen         TYPE   i,",
    "        lv_progname       TYPE   trdir-name,",
    "        lv_comment        TYPE   tadir-obj_name,",
    "        lv_fdpos          TYPE   sy-fdpos,",
    "        lv_invalid_name   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_prefix_checked TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_prefix_found   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_wrong_syntax   TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_is_ldba        TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_is_ok          TYPE   c,",
    "        lv_result         TYPE   trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_stem           TYPE   e071-obj_name.",
    "",
    "",
    "  DATA: ls_dderr TYPE dderr,",
    "        ls_tlock TYPE tlock_int,",
    "        ls_tadir TYPE tadir,",
    "        ls_e071  TYPE e071.",
    "",
    "  DATA: lv_tablen LIKE SY-FDPOS,",
    "        lv_OFFSET LIKE SY-FDPOS,",
    "        lv_indname(3) type c,",
    "        lv_tabname  type dd02l-tabname,",
    "        lv_xinx_cts_name TYPE e071-obj_name.",
    "",
    "  DATA: lv_name_doc_tem(60)  TYPE c.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS:  <testobj>.",
    "",
    "  DEFINE translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "    if iv_translate_objname = 'X'.",
    "      call function 'TRINT_TRANSLATE_TO_UPPER'",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          cv_string = we_e071-obj_name.",
    "    endif.",
    "  END-OF-DEFINITION.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: tr_lpart[].",
    "  pe_result = 'F'.        \" initialize (value is used internally only)",
    "",
    "* fill output E071 and make all further changes there",
    "  we_e071 = wi_e071.",
    "",
    "  IF   we_e071-pgmid(1)    =    '*'",
    "  OR   we_e071-pgmid       =    'PASS'.",
    "    MOVE  'I'  TO  ev_langtyp.",
    "    pe_result = 'S'.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  we_lock_key-pat_len = 2.",
    "* check object name for non standard characters (UNICODE-project)",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'SCP_CHARS_ARE_SYNTACTICAL'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      string = we_e071-obj_name",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      is_ok  = lv_is_ok.",
    "  IF lv_is_ok <> 'X'.",
    "    ev_name_with_nonstandard_chars = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF we_e071-pgmid = 'LANG'.",
    "* special treatment for language objects: check filled language field",
    "    IF we_e071-lang = space OR we_e071-lang = '*'.",
    "      ev_invalid_language_field = 'X'.",
    "      pe_result = space.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CASE we_e071-pgmid.",
    "    WHEN 'LIMU' OR 'LANG'.",
    "      IF we_e071-object <> 'ADIR'.",
    "        translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      CASE we_e071-object.",
    "* only TADIR entry",
    "        WHEN 'ADIR'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'F'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          DESCRIBE FIELD ls_tadir-obj_name LENGTH  lv_tadir_maxlen",
    "                                                     IN CHARACTER MODE.",
    "          ls_e071-pgmid       =    we_e071-obj_name(4).",
    "          ls_e071-object      =    we_e071-obj_name+4(4).",
    "          ls_e071-obj_name    =    we_e071-obj_name+8(lv_tadir_maxlen).",
    "          IF   ls_e071-pgmid  =    'LIMU'",
    "          AND  ls_e071-object =    'ADIR'.",
    "            pe_result      =    ' '.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'TR_CHECK_TYPE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              wi_e071           = ls_e071",
    "            IMPORTING",
    "              pe_result         = lv_result",
    "              we_lock_key       = ls_tlock",
    "              we_tadir          = ls_tadir",
    "              ev_case_sensitive = ev_case_sensitive.",
    "          pe_result = lv_result.",
    "          IF   ev_case_sensitive <> 'X'.",
    "            translate_to_upper_obj_name.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF   we_e071-obj_name(4)      ><   ls_tadir-pgmid",
    "          OR   we_e071-obj_name+4(4)    ><   ls_tadir-object",
    "          OR   we_e071-obj_name+8(lv_tadir_maxlen)",
    "                                        ><   ls_tadir-obj_name",
    "          OR   pe_result                NA   'TL'.",
    "            pe_result                =    ' '.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "          objlen = ls_tlock-len + 8.",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len = ls_tlock-pat_len.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     = ls_tlock-obj.",
    "          we_tadir            = ls_tadir.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'ADIR' 4.",
    "",
    "* ABAP-source and texts",
    "        WHEN 'REPO'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPO' 4.",
    "",
    "* only ABAP-source.",
    "        WHEN 'REPS'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'F'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old .",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          IF we_tadir-object = 'CLAS'.",
    "** belongs to OO-ABAP, tr_lpart is already complete  (<CLAS>REPS only)",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPOREPS' 8.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* only reporttext.",
    "        WHEN 'REPT'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'L'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_prog .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          IF we_tadir-object = 'CLAS'.",
    "** belongs to OO-ABAP, tr_lpart is already complete  (<CLAS>REPT only)",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'REPOREPT' 8.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* report variants (System variants)",
    "        WHEN 'VARI'.",
    "***Position of variant-name in E071 differs due to length of progname***",
    "***offset for reading in  E071 is calculated in LV_PROG             ****",
    "***however hikey is build with long progname in any case            ****",
    "          lv_length1     = gc_prog_old + gc_vari.",
    "          lv_length2     = STRLEN( we_e071-obj_name ).",
    "          IF lv_length2  > lv_length1.",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name   = we_e071-obj_name.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name    = we_e071-obj_name(gc_prog_old).",
    "            ls_e071-obj_name+gc_prog =",
    "                            we_e071-obj_name+gc_prog_old(gc_vari).",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog_old.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    lv_prog  + gc_vari .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old + gc_vari_old .",
    "          we_cli_dep     =   'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                 USING we_lock_key",
    "                       we_e071-object ls_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                       ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                       lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          lv_objname = we_e071-obj_name+lv_prog(gc_vari).",
    "          IF lv_objname NE space",
    "          OR we_tadir-object NE 'PROG'.",
    "* new entry LIMU VARI: specific variant",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                    USING 'VARI' 4 lv_objname gc_vari .",
    "          ELSE.",
    "* old entry LIMU VARI (rel. 2.2): all variants",
    "            PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'VARI' 4.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "* report variants (application variants)",
    "        WHEN 'VARX'.",
    "          lv_length1     = gc_prog_old + gc_vari.",
    "          lv_length2     = STRLEN( we_e071-obj_name ).",
    "          IF lv_length2  > lv_length1.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_prog    = gc_prog_old.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          pe_result      =    'R'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'CUST'.",
    "          objlen         =    lv_prog  + gc_vari .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_prog_old  + gc_vari_old .",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "* field selections",
    "        WHEN 'FSEL'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_fsel .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_fsel_old.",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                 USING we_lock_key",
    "                       we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                       ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                       lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'FSEL' 4.",
    "* 'Bildfolgesteuerung'",
    "        WHEN 'SSCT'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_ssct .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_ssct_old.",
    "          we_cli_dep     =    'X'.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING we_lock_key",
    "                        we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                       we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                        ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                        lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'SSCT' 4.",
    "* GUI-definition",
    "        WHEN 'CUAD'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'M'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_cuad .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_cuad_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "               USING we_lock_key",
    "                     we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                     we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                     ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                     lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part1  TABLES tr_lpart USING 'CUAD' 4.",
    "* GUI-definition texts",
    "        WHEN 'CUAX'.",
    "          pe_result      =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp     =    'L'.",
    "          we_category    =    'SYST'.",
    "          lv_tadir_len   =    gc_prog.",
    "          objlen         =    gc_cuad .",
    "          objlen_old     =    gc_cuad_old.",
    "          PERFORM trint_repo_type TABLES tr_lpart",
    "               USING we_lock_key",
    "                     we_e071-object we_e071-obj_name pe_result",
    "                     we_tadir-pgmid we_tadir-object we_tadir-obj_name",
    "                     ev_namespace ev_invalid_prefix_syntax",
    "                     lv_prefix_checked.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                  USING 'CUAD' 4 'CUAX' 4.",
    "",
    "* OO-ABAP: Definition of class",
    "        WHEN 'CLSD'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CLSD' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: class include/macro",
    "        WHEN 'CINC'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'F'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_prog.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          TRANSLATE we_tadir-obj_name  USING '= '.     \"remove '='",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part3 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas",
    "                     'CINC' 4  we_e071-obj_name(gc_prog) gc_prog.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Private header",
    "        WHEN 'CPRI'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CPRI' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Protected header",
    "        WHEN 'CPRO'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",
    "          we_tadir-obj_name   =    we_e071-obj_name(gc_clas).",
    "          we_lock_key-pat_len =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_lock_key-obj     =    we_tadir-object.",
    "          PERFORM tr_next_part2 TABLES tr_lpart",
    "                USING  we_tadir-obj_name gc_clas 'CPRO' 4.",
    "* OO-ABAP: Public header",
    "        WHEN 'CPUB'.",
    "          pe_result           =    'L'.",
    "          ev_langtyp          =    'M'.",
    "          we_category         =    'SYST'.",
    "          objlen              =    gc_clas.",
    "          we_tadir-pgmid      =    'R3TR'.",
    "          we_tadir-object     =    'CLAS'.",

    "FUNCTION tr_sys_params.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEMEDIT) LIKE  TADIR-EDTFLAG",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEMNAME) LIKE  SY-SYSID",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEMTYPE) LIKE  SY-SYSID",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEM_CLIENT_EDIT) LIKE  T000-CCCORACTIV",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYS_CLIINDDEP_EDIT) LIKE  T000-CCNOCLIIND",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEM_CLIENT_ROLE) LIKE  T000-CCCATEGORY",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SFW_BCSET_REC) TYPE  T000-CCORIGCONT",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_C_SYSTEM) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMNAME",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMTYPE",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: gcon_tr_sys_params  TYPE context_tr_sys_params,",
    "        lt_symsg            LIKE symsg OCCURS 0,",
    "        ls_symsg            LIKE symsg,",
    "        lv_use_context      TYPE c       VALUE 'X'.",
    "",
    "* Former parameter EV_C_SYSTEM was used to mark",
    "* development system for C-sources.",
    "* Not used any more, but not deleted for compatibility reasons.",
    "  ev_c_system = space.",
    "",
    "  IF lv_use_context = 'X'.",
    "*   use of context (with security mechanism)",
    "*   Context buffer is implicitely client dependent, so we do not need to",
    "*   set the client explicitely",
    "    SUPPLY i_dummy = 'X' TO CONTEXT gcon_tr_sys_params.",
    "    DEMAND  e_systemedit     = systemedit",
    "            e_systemname     = systemname",
    "            e_systemtype     = systemtype",
    "            e_client_edit    = system_client_edit",
    "            e_cliinddep_edit = sys_cliinddep_edit",
    "            e_client_role    = system_client_role",
    "            e_sfw_bcset_rec  = ev_sfw_bcset_rec",
    "                         FROM CONTEXT gcon_tr_sys_params",
    "                         MESSAGES INTO lt_symsg.",
    "",
    "    READ TABLE lt_symsg INDEX 1 INTO ls_symsg.",
    "    IF sy-subrc   = 0                  \"  ERROR OCCURED!!!!",
    "    OR systemname = space.",
    "      MESSAGE ID     ls_symsg-msgid",
    "              TYPE   'I'               \"ls_symsg-msgty",
    "              NUMBER ls_symsg-msgno",
    "              WITH   ls_symsg-msgv1 ls_symsg-msgv2",
    "                     ls_symsg-msgv3 ls_symsg-msgv4.",
    "",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_SYS_PARAMS_CONTEXT_MODULE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          dummy            = 'X'",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          systemedit       = systemedit",
    "          systemname       = systemname",
    "          systemtype       = systemtype",
    "          system_client_ed = system_client_edit",
    "          sys_cliinddep_ed = sys_cliinddep_edit",
    "          system_client_ro = system_client_role",
    "          ev_sfw_bcset_rec = ev_sfw_bcset_rec",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          no_systemname    = 1",
    "          no_systemtype    = 2.",
    "      CASE sy-subrc.",
    "        WHEN 1. current_message_raising no_systemname.",
    "        WHEN 2. current_message_raising no_systemtype.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  ELSE.                                \"\" old behaviour",
    "    DATA: lv_len              TYPE i,",
    "          ls_tadir            LIKE tadir,",
    "          ls_t000             LIKE t000,",
    "          lv_system_type      LIKE sy-sysid.",
    "",
    "*** find system name **************************************************",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir",
    "           WHERE pgmid     =  'HEAD'",
    "           AND   object    =  'SYST'",
    "           AND   obj_name  =  space.",
    "    IF   sy-subrc  <>   0.",
    "      MESSAGE e732(tk) RAISING no_systemname.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** find system type **************************************************",
    "    CALL 'C_SAPGPARAM'  ID 'NAME'  FIELD 'transport/systemtype'",
    "                        ID 'VALUE' FIELD lv_system_type.",
    "    IF   sy-subrc  <>   0.",
    "      MESSAGE e105(tk)",
    "              WITH     'transport/systemtype'",
    "              RAISING  no_systemtype.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      lv_len  =    STRLEN( ls_tadir-srcsystem ).",
    "      IF   lv_len  <>   3.",
    "        MESSAGE e842(tr)",
    "                WITH    ls_tadir-srcsystem",
    "                RAISING no_systemname.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF   sy-sysid  ><   ls_tadir-srcsystem.",
    "      MESSAGE e732(tk) RAISING no_systemname.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    systemname = ls_tadir-srcsystem.",
    "    systemedit = ls_tadir-edtflag.",
    "    systemtype = lv_system_type.",
    "",
    "*** read client attributes **********************************************",
    "    IF system_client_edit IS REQUESTED",
    "    OR sys_cliinddep_edit IS REQUESTED",
    "    OR system_client_role IS REQUESTED",
    "    OR ev_sfw_bcset_rec   IS REQUESTED.",
    "",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM t000 INTO ls_t000",
    "                                WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.",
    "      IF   sy-subrc  =  0.",
    "        system_client_edit  =  ls_t000-cccoractiv.",
    "        sys_cliinddep_edit  =  ls_t000-ccnocliind.",
    "        system_client_role  =  ls_t000-cccategory.",
    "        ev_sfw_bcset_rec    =  ls_t000-ccorigcont.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        system_client_edit  =  ' '.",
    "        sys_cliinddep_edit  =  ' '.",
    "        system_client_role  =  ' '.",
    "        ev_sfw_bcset_rec    =  ' '.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

    "            OR '0003'",
